other_conditions: Student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Student must be studying in any recognized and reputed college in Andhra Pradesh for the academic year
Parents should be residing in Andhra Pradesh
Student must have cleared all subjects of the previous year
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
Student must not have availed any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose, except benefits from Archaka Welfare Trust
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 for graduation students.
